title: Market Data Infrastructure Engineer (LATAM)
description:
IMPORTANT: Eligible locations in LATAM: Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Mexico.


Company Description

Amaris Consulting is an independent technology consulting firm with a global footprint, bringing together diverse talents from various backgrounds to deliver innovative solutions to clients worldwide. We are committed to excellence, collaboration, and consistently exceeding performance expectations across a wide range of industries.


Our Client

Our client is one of the world's leading investment banks, founded in the 19th century, offers a broad range of services, including investment banking, securities trading, and asset management. It specializes in advising on mergers, acquisitions, and capital-raising activities for major corporations and governments. Known for its strong presence in global financial markets, the firm provides market-making and trading services across various asset classes. It has earned a reputation for shaping the financial landscape on Wall Street and beyond. The organization is also committed to philanthropy and sustainability through its various initiatives and programs.


Role Description

We are looking for a skilled professional to join our Market Data Infrastructure team, focused on managing and resolving infrastructure issues and ensuring optimal performance of real-time data services.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Resolving Data quality issues, this includes root cause analysis while managing internal and external vendors to resolve Data issues.
  • Support On-call, incident management, problem and change managements.
  • Ensuring optimal accuracy and timeliness of Data on a real-time basis while implementing monitoring tools to detect data issues.
  • Work closely with regional and global Market Data Infrastructure teams to share knowledge and experience to enrich the team's capability and work together to provide a high level quality of services on Market Data.
  • L2 Alert Management. Management of alerts that require knowledge for resolutions, creating and/or updating resolutions into knowledge base, run books, scripts and ITRS rules where possible
  • Incident Management. Managing of incident lifecycle from identification to resolution, ensuring mitigation of business impact in the production environment.
  • Change Management. Management of the process of making production changes to the ticker plant like Mandatory updates which includes content, software changes/upgrades that are performed by vendors or internal teams where only checkouts are necessary.
  • Others: Release Management, Event Management, User support, Reporting.


What We're Looking For?

• Minimum 3-5 years of experience

• Experience with Market Data Thomson Reuters Enterprise Platform (TREP) or Refinitiv Real-Time Distribution System (RTDS) and DACS .

• Good understanding of Market Data platforms e.g. Refinitiv, Bloomberg, direct feed providers.

• Proficient with Linux/ Windows operating systems and network level tuning and editing scripts - preferred scripting language: Bash/Python.

• Experience with networking and connectivity skills e.g. multicast , routing, switches, TCP/IP.

• Good communication and oral and written English skills is a must

• Understanding of ITIL Foundation and IT Best practices

• Skills which are not mandatory but are advantage:

o Geneos ITRS

o EXEGY (formerly Wombat/Vela)

o Market Data API

o AWS ECS, AWS VPC, including VPC Endpoints


What We Offer?

  • A modern, dynamic, and future-oriented company
  • Remote work, or Hybrid based on candidates’ preferences
  • Continuous development and training opportunities
  • A competitive salary package with additional social benefits
  • Interesting and challenging tasks
  • The opportunity to work in an international and multicultural environment
  • Regular team events
  • Long-term career prospects

title: Pessoa Analista de BI SR
description:
#Nosso jeito de fazer história:

Entre para a história de construção do maior Hub de Dados e Analytics do Brasil.

Além de você contribuir diretamente neste objetivo, você estará se desenvolvendo constantemente, por meio de grandes desafios de negócio, junto a um time de alto impacto. Na Neoway, acreditamos em fazer as coisas de forma inovadora, colaborativa, responsável e com foco no cliente.


Missão do Cargo:

Entregar aos nossos clientes soluções voltadas a Business Intelligence, proporcionando a eles acesso a informações relevantes e necessárias para a tomada de decisão.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Construção de ETLs
  • Modelagem de dados
  • Desenvolvimento de dashboards
  • Monitoramento de cargas
  • Automatização de processos
  • Administração de processos (server, aplicações, schedules, bases de dados, etc)
  • Suporte aos clientes internos e externos
  • Analise de viabilidade e estimativa de projetos
  • Analise e desenvolvimento de micro serviços (APIs) para dados de BI


Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Vivência com Power BI, DBT, Python, BigQuery, SQL;
  • Capacidade em trabalho em equipe, foco em resultados, mantendo-se atualizado frente as novas tecnologias do mercado;
  • Fluidez no relacionamento com diferentes áreas;
  • Capacidade analítica e interpretativa para solução de problemas.


Diferencial:

  • Conhecimento em QlikView, Pentaho;
  • Conhecimento em Script Shell;
  • Conhecimento em banco de dados MongoDb;
  • Conhecimento em linguagens como Javascript e Node js;
  • Docker e Git.

title: Remote Digital Operations Coordinator
description:
Hiring: Remote Digital Operations Coordinator (Technical Operations Specialist )

Company: Copy Squad

Reports to: CEO/Owner

Status: FULL-TIME / CONTRACT

Location: Remote


Position Overview

Do you love building systems that make everything run smoother?


Are you energized by automation, tech integrations, and streamlining workflows across multiple brands?


Do you thrive behind the scenes, keeping operations tight while freeing up creative leaders to stay in their zone of genius?


Then Copy Squad wants you on the team.


About The Company

We’re hiring a Remote Digital Operations Coordinator / Technical Operations Specialist to serve as an integrator across three brands, Copy Squad, PickJunkies, and our agency division. In this role, you’ll work directly with the CEO to build and maintain automations, streamline onboarding, organize creative assets, and analyze performance data. Your contributions will form the operational backbone of the business, enabling the creative team to stay focused on strategy and growth.


Copy Squad is a boutique agency that helps businesses scale through direct-response copywriting and strategic marketing. We specialize in high-converting funnels, email campaigns, and sales pages that deliver measurable results. Our culture values autonomy, clarity, and execution. We’re lean, agile, and driven by outcomes, not fluff.

This role is ideal for someone who is tech-savvy, proactive, and thrives on solving operational challenges. If you’re energized by creating systems, managing complexity, and turning ideas into action, you’ll fit right in.


Learn more about the company HERE.


Responsibilities

  • Build and manage automations in GoHighLevel (tags, triggers, email/SMS sequences, upsell/downsell flows)
  • Automate cross-sell and upsell campaigns (e.g., lifetime pass offers triggered post-purchase)
  • Integrate fulfillment extras (e.g., Printify t-shirt delivery) into automation stack
  • Maintain and optimize onboarding sequences from purchase → Discord → product access
  • Simplify onboarding for less tech-savvy users with walkthroughs and explainer videos
  • Maintain a centralized swipe file system for copywriters (Notion-based)
  • Organize and distribute high-performing promos, emails, and ads for easy access if requested by writers.
  • Use GoHighLevel API or integrations to track email performance (open/click rates)
  • Gather top-performing client promos and store them for internal use
  • Maintain templated assets for junior-level tasks (order forms, upsells, offers)
  • Ensure funnels (opt-ins, follow-ups, upsells) are running and optimized
  • Implement upsell triggers and fulfillment automation
  • Act as an ops partner across all brands, tying together tech, customer experience, and internal processes
  • Take over low-leverage tasks currently handled by the CEO and design lead
  • Focus first 30/60/90 days on agency swipe system, PickJunkies onboarding, and Copy Squad automations


Requirements

  • Exceptional fluency in English across reading, writing, and verbal communication
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in digital marketing or a similar agency environment (preferred)
  • Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience with automations, integrations, and system optimization
  • Minimum 2 years of project management experience using PM tools (e.g., ClickUp, Asana—not ticketing platforms)
  • Leadership experience in managing teams or cross-functional projects (preferred)
  • Familiarity with copywriting and marketing funnels (preferred)
  • Strong technical aptitude; comfortable working with automation platforms and digital tools
  • Proven ability to identify inefficiencies and implement long-term, scalable solutions
  • Skilled in breaking down complex projects into clear, actionable steps
  • Capable of making sound decisions independently and managing multiple priorities


Additional requirements:

  • Available to work in U.S. EST time zones
  • Access to a computer and basic tech setup
  • Reliable internet connection
  • Reliable and distraction-free work environment
  • Financial industry knowledge is helpful
  • Project Management tool experience with Notion or similar software, highly preferred (Not ticketing tools like Jira)


This position is for a person who is:

  • Highly organized and detail-oriented
  • Strong follow-through and task completion skills
  • Proactive self-starter who takes initiative without needing micromanagement
  • Operates with a sense of urgency and accountability
  • Comfortable being direct and assertive, especially around deadlines
  • Professional and composed in fast-paced environments
  • Solution-oriented with a positive, can-do attitude
  • Takes ownership and avoids excuses
  • Motivated by impact and loves getting things done


This position is NOT for someone who:

  • Struggles with follow-through or self-management
  • Has to be pushed to do their job
  • Prefers a slow-paced work environment
  • Lacks a sense of urgency
  • Thinks “good enough is good enough”
  • Makes excuses
  • Doesn’t care about getting exceptional results
  • Is unavailable to work during U.S. EST time zone
  • Can’t stand political conservative viewpoints
  • Hates the financial industry


Software Utilized by Company

GoHighLevel, Notion, Google Workspace, Printify


Offer Details

  • Full-time, remote, contractor position
  • BRL: R$6.720,00 - BRL: R$7.280,00/month
  • No benefits provided


Our Cultural Pillars :

  • We are professionals. We get the job done, done right, and done on time.
  • We deliver high-quality work.
  • We are efficient but not frenetic.
  • We use systems and processes to stay on task and finish on time.
  • We do not make excuses.


Interview Process :

To better allow you to display your skills and to help us determine the best candidates, our recruiting process is approximately four to five weeks and takes place in four rounds:

  • Initial Application
  • Skills Application
  • Live interview with our recruiting agency
  • Final interview with CEO or manager

If selected, you will be invited by email to progress to the next round.

  • Proven ability to identify inefficiencies and implement long-term, scalable solutions
  • Skilled in breaking down complex projects into clear, actionable steps
  • Capable of making sound decisions independently and managing multiple priorities


Additional requirements:

  • Available to work in U.S. EST time zones
  • Access to a computer and basic tech setup
  • Reliable internet connection
  • Reliable and distraction-free work environment
  • Financial industry knowledge is helpful
  • Project Management tool experience with Notion or similar software, highly preferred (Not ticketing tools like Jira)


This position is for a person who is:

  • Highly organized and detail-oriented
  • Strong follow-through and task completion skills
  • Proactive self-starter who takes initiative without needing micromanagement
  • Operates with a sense of urgency and accountability
  • Comfortable being direct and assertive, especially around deadlines
  • Professional and composed in fast-paced environments
  • Solution-oriented with a positive, can-do attitude
  • Takes ownership and avoids excuses
  • Motivated by impact and loves getting things done


This position is NOT for someone who:

  • Struggles with follow-through or self-management
  • Has to be pushed to do their job
  • Prefers a slow-paced work environment
  • Lacks a sense of urgency
  • Thinks “good enough is good enough”
  • Makes excuses
  • Doesn’t care about getting exceptional results
  • Is unavailable to work during U.S. EST time zone
  • Can’t stand political conservative viewpoints
  • Hates the financial industry


Software Utilized by Company

GoHighLevel, Notion, Google Workspace, Printify


Offer Details

  • Full-time, remote, contractor position
  • BRL: R$6.720,00 - BRL: R$7.280,00/month
  • No benefits provided


Our Cultural Pillars :

  • We are professionals. We get the job done, done right, and done on time.
  • We deliver high-quality work.
  • We are efficient but not frenetic.
  • We use systems and processes to stay on task and finish on time.
  • We do not make excuses.


Interview Process :

To better allow you to display your skills and to help us determine the best candidates, our recruiting process is approximately four to five weeks and takes place in four rounds:

  • Initial Application
  • Skills Application
  • Live interview with our recruiting agency
  • Final interview with CEO or manager

If selected, you will be invited by email to progress to the next round.

title: Consultor(a) de Relacionamento_Salvador(BA)_Vaga Afirmativa para Pessoas Negras
description:
Sobre a vaga:


A Juntos Somos Mais é uma startup de tecnologia atuando no mercado da construção civil desde 2018 que tem como acionistas três gigantes do mercado: Votorantim Cimentos, Gerdau e Tigre.


Fazemos isso por meio de tecnologia, com produtos próprios, parcerias, aquisições e com um time empreendedor, de alta performance, que é movido pela nossa paixão em transformar vidas! Hoje contamos com mais de 40 marcas participantes, mais de 1.2 milhões de membros entre lojistas, vendedores e profissionais de obra, 100 mil lojas e movimentamos mais de 10 bilhões de reais em nossa Loja Virtual em 2024, e crescemos mais a cada dia.


O nosso time é empreendedor e apaixonado por propor as melhores soluções para os nossos usuários, fortalecendo o varejo de materiais de construção e impactando a vida de milhares de pessoas. Através disso, construímos relações sólidas para sermos o maior ecossistema da construção civil.


Você fará parte do time Comercial.


Base: Salvador(BA)


Você será a conexão direta entre a nossa Loja Virtual e as lojas de material de construção da sua região.

Seu papel será garantir que as lojas parceiras entendam, usem e se beneficiem do nosso marketplace, fortalecendo nossa presença em campo, ofertando as indústrias participantes e trazendo aprendizados para dentro de casa.


Seu dia a dia será assim:

  • Visitar lojas da sua carteira para converter o cliente com pedidos na nossa Loja Virtual;
  • Tirar dúvidas sobre campanhas, regras e funcionalidades;
  • Apoiar as indústrias e distribuidores parceiros localmente, sendo um ponto de contato estratégico e confiável;
  • Trazer feedbacks e insights valiosos do campo para apoiar o time de produto, marketing e operações;
  • Colaborar com times internos na ativação de novos sellers do marketplace;
  • Monitorar tendências do varejo e concorrência na região;
  • Manter relacionamento próximo com donos, gerentes e vendedores — somos uma marca próxima e presente!


O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência prévia em área comercial (presencial);
  • Boa comunicação e escuta ativa — você vai lidar com muitos perfis diferentes;
  • Organização para lidar com uma carteira diversa e realizar visitas diárias;
  • Interesse genuíno em aprender sobre o setor de material de construção (experiência prévia é um plus!);
  • Perfil que resolve, propõe e faz acontecer;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens dentro da região;
  • Ensino superior em andamento ou concluído (Administração, Marketing, Comércio Exterior ou áreas afins);
  • CNH válida e Excel no mínimo intermediário.


O que pode te destacar:

  • Conhecimento prévio em marketplace B2B;
  • Ter atuado com rotina externa e visitas diárias;
  • Ter facilidade para apresentar, treinar e engajar clientes.


Por que vale a pena:

Você vai trabalhar em um programa que conecta varejo, indústria e tecnologia para transformar um dos setores mais importantes do país — e fazer isso com autonomia, responsabilidade e muita troca. Aqui, a gente valoriza quem constrói junto, compartilha aprendizados e busca soluções com propósito.


Nosso processo seletivo e compromisso com a diversidade

Na #Juntos, valorizamos a jornada de aprendizagem mútua: queremos descobrir, juntos, o potencial de cada pessoa em todas as etapas do processo. Nosso objetivo é criar uma experiência transparente, justa e eficiente, alinhada aos nossos valores e à nossa cultura de protagonismo e impacto.


Acreditamos que um time diverso e autêntico é essencial para gerar soluções verdadeiramente inovadoras. Aqui, você será encorajado a ser você mesmo(a), trazendo suas singularidades para somar ao coletivo. Promovemos inclusão de forma concreta, com ações afirmativas que buscam ampliar vozes de diferentes origens e perspectivas.


Se você busca um ambiente onde pode ser quem é, aprender com liberdade e contribuir com impacto real, seu lugar pode ser aqui. Vem construir com a gente o maior ecossistema da construção civil!

title: Representante de Propaganda Médica
description:
Na Exeltis, acreditamos no poder da conexão e do conhecimento para transformar vidas.


Estamos em busca de Representante de Propaganda Médica com paixão por impactar positivamente a jornada das pacientes, por meio de um relacionamento próximo com médicos e farmácias.

Se você tem energia, atitude protagonista, foco em resultados e deseja crescer em um ambiente dinâmico e desafiador, essa oportunidade é para você!


Local de atuação: Salvador – BA


Como será seu dia a dia:

  • Realizar visitas médicas e em pontos de venda (PDVs) de forma estratégica, promovendo nosso portfólio com excelência.
  • Gerir o painel médico e farmacêutico, mantendo o cadastro sempre atualizado, com foco na geração de demanda qualificada.
  • Planejar roteiros de visita com base em metas e indicadores de performance.
  • Monitorar os resultados das ações em campo e propor estratégias para superação de metas.
  • Organizar e participar de eventos, treinamentos e ações promocionais com médicos e farmácias.
  • Controlar e distribuir amostras grátis de maneira responsável e conforme as normas internas.
  • Realizar lançamentos em sistema e relatórios de visita, contribuindo para a inteligência de mercado.
  • Garantir a presença e a visibilidade dos produtos nos pontos de venda da sua região.
  • Aplicar as estratégias da empresa com base em sólido conhecimento técnico e habilidades de vendas.


Requisitos para brilhar nessa vaga:

  • Ensino superior completo.
  • CNH B ativa.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens frequentes.
  • Pacote Office em nível intermediário.
  • Experiência no setor farmacêutico.
  • Residir em: Salvador - BA


Você vai arrasar se tiver:

  • Pós-graduação em áreas relacionadas à saúde ou gestão.
  • Experiência no setor farmacêutico com foco em saúde feminina .
  • Conhecimento em estratégias de demanda e relacionamento.


Habilidades que fazem a diferença:

  • Foco em resultados, com forte orientação para metas.
  • Excelente comunicação e poder de argumentação.
  • Organização, disciplina e proatividade.
  • Capacidade de análise de dados e identificação de oportunidades.
  • Espírito de equipe e colaboração.

title: Acquisition Editor, Life Science
description:
JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role

We are seeking an ambitious individual to join our team as an Acquisition Editor. In this role, you will focus on recruiting new authors and content for our Journal.


Responsibilities:

  • Identify and recruit new authors, guiding them through the manuscript submission process for JoVE Journal.
  • Contact potential Guest Editors and collaborate with them to build a Methods Collections, our version of a special issue.
  • Establish and maintain a strong network of scientists/journal authors to drive content acquisition and grow submission rates.
  • Collaborate with the peer review team to facilitate the publication of manuscripts.
  • Meet or exceed monthly acquisition targets.


Requirements:

  • A Ph.D. in the Life Sciences.
  • Fluent English written and verbal communication skills.
  • Results-driven, with an ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organizational, influencing and problem-solving skills.
  • Familiarity with the publishing process is a plus.


Why Join JoVE?

  • You can expect compensation competitively placed within the local market, including unlimited bonus for manuscript acquisition.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and discovery.
  • Opportunity to work in a remote environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

title: Salesforce Business Analyst
description:
We are HCLTech, one of the world’s largest and fastest growing technology and DSA companies with over 227,000 professionals across 60 countries, driving progress through industry-leading capabilities focused on Digital, Engineering and Cloud.


The driving force behind this work, our people, is a diverse, creative and passionate audience that enables us to continually raise the bar for excellence in our services. We strive to empower each of our professionals to achieve their best, while also striving to help them find their daily inspiration and become the best version of themselves.


We are looking for a highly talented and self-motivated to join us on our journey to advance the world of technology through innovation and creativity.


Key Responsibilities

  • Gather and document business requirements: Engage with stakeholders to elicit, clarify, and translate business needs into functional specifications for Salesforce implementations.
  • Business process analysis: Map, analyze, and optimize business processes, identifying gaps and opportunities for improvement using Salesforce functionalities.
  • Solution design & configuration: Collaborate closely with IT and stakeholders to design, configure, and implement Salesforce solutions that align with organizational goals.
  • Data analysis & reporting: Prepare technical reports, dashboards, and visualizations by collecting and analyzing business data and CRM trends.
  • Testing & training: Conduct user acceptance testing (UAT), prepare training materials, and facilitate learning sessions for end-users to ensure successful adoption of new solutions.
  • Stakeholder collaboration: Communicate clearly with business leaders, project managers, developers, and end-users to ensure requirements are fully understood and solutions deliver maximum value.
  • Continuous improvement: Gather feedback post-implementation, monitor solution performance, and iterate on Salesforce configurations for ongoing optimization.


Requirements:

  • In-depth knowledge of Salesforce Sales cloud, Quote, Order and Contract Management Testing (UAT)
  • Business case writing, wireframing, and flow diagrams.
  • Salesforce configuration and administration.
  • Basic programming/scripting (Apex, SOQL) is advantageous.


Soft Skills:

Analytical thinking & problem-solving.

Effective oral and written communication.

Requirement gathering & documentation.

Process mapping & diagramming.

Stakeholder management & facilitation.

title: Lead Data Engineer - DBA Oracle performance
description:
What are we looking for?

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Lead Data Engineer to design, develop, and lead the delivery of enterprise-grade data integration and analytics solutions. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in Oracle performance tuning and Oracle Data Integrator (ODI), combined with strong leadership and communication skills. In this role, you will lead technical decision-making, mentor team members, and collaborate with DBAs and business stakeholders to deliver high-performance, scalable data solutions.


Key Responsibilities

· Optimize query and database performance to meet strict SLAs (<2 seconds).

· Analyze execution plans and recommend indexing, partitioning, and optimization strategies.

· Partner with DBAs to validate and implement tuning recommendations.

· Oversee ETL/ELT workflows, ensuring scalability, efficiency, and data quality.

· Leverage AWS services (S3, Redshift, Glue, Lambda, DMS) for ingestion, transformation, and storage.

· Lead and mentor the team, fostering technical excellence and continuous improvement.

· Translate technical decisions into clear explanations for both technical and business stakeholders.


Required Qualifications

· 7+ years of experience in data engineering within enterprise-scale environments.

· Expertise in Oracle performance tuning, including query optimization, execution plans, indexes, partitioning, and parallelism.

· Hands-on experience writing and optimizing complex SQL queries.

· Expertise in Oracle Data Integrator (ODI).

· Experience in data warehouse design, ETL/ELT processes, and data modeling.

· Proven leadership experience, including team mentoring and technical guidance.

· Excellent communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with DBAs, technical teams, and business stakeholders.

· Fluent in English.


Nice to Have

· Hands-on experience with AWS data services (S3, Redshift, Glue, Lambda, DMS).

· Prior experience in Wealth Management.

Location: Remote (preferably based in São Leopoldo/RS or Porto Alegre/RS region)


Why build your carrer at Meta?

We offer autonomy, clear goals and a dynamic and challenging environment, where professionals have the opportunity to interact with different technologies, participate in all types of projects, bring new ideas and work from anywhere in Brazil and (why not?) anywhere in the world. In addition, we are one of the best companies to work for in Brazil according to Great Place to Work and one of the 10 fastest growing technology companies in the country for 3 consecutive years, according to Anuário Informático Hoje.


What are our values?

- We are people serving people

- We all think and act like owners

- We are hungry for performance

- We grow and learn together

- We pursue excellence and simplicity

- We have innovation and creativity in our DNA

All people are welcome regardless of their condition, disability, ethnicity, religious belief, sexual orientation, appearance, age or others. We want you to grow up with us in a welcoming environment full of opportunities.

Did you relate? Then, #ComeBeMeta!

title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora Back-end .NET - Sênior
description:
Descrição da vaga


A FCamara está em busca de uma Pessoa Desenvolvedora Backend .NET para atuar em parceria com o maior Banco de Investimentos da América Latina, especializado em capital de investimento, de risco, além de gerenciamento de patrimônio e ativos globais.


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Levantar requisitos, desenvolver e corrigir problemas em aplicações;
  • Promover a automatização e otimização de processos e análises;
  • Relacionamento próximo com as áreas de negócio e outras equipes de IT do Grupo BTG Pactual;
  • Garantir a alta disponibilidade das plataformas criando e evoluindo processos de deploy (blue/green e canary deployment);
  • Desenvolvimento de software seguindo metodologias ágeis e utilizando as melhores práticas de orientação a objetos e de clean code.


Requisitos e qualificações


Hard Skills:

  • Experiencia com nuvem (AWS, GCP, Azure, etc)
  • Experiência com .NET (C#)
  • Experience com banco de dados relacional (SQLServer, MySql, Postgres)
  • Design Patterns;
  • Experiência com testes unitários (TDD);
  • Conhecimento em GIT;
  • Conhecimento de metodologias ágeis (Scrum);
  • Conhecimento em Docker, Kubernets;
  • Conhecimento em frameworks de messageria (Kafka, ActiveMQ, RabbitMQ, etc..);
  • Boa comunicação e trabalho em equipe;
  • Capacidade de escrever código robusto, testável e validado;
  • Conhecimento em aplicações que precisem responder em alta disponibilidade e alta performance.

Desejáveis:

  • Conhecimento de Mercado Financeiro;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de Code Quality (sonar);
  • Experiência com ferramentas de APM (Dynatrace, AppDynamics, DataDog, etc...);
  • Conhecimento em Prometheus, metricas e monitoramento;
  • Experiência com aplicações SPA;
  • Conhecimento em ElasticSearch, Apache Lucene e GraphQL;
  • Experiência trabalhando com implantação e gerenciamento de nuvem;
  • Experiência com gerenciamento e implantação de CI/CD.

Soft Skills:

  • Raciocínio lógico e capacidade analítica;
  • Boa Comunicação;
  • Espírito de equipe e capacidade de resolução de conflitos;
  • Ter capacidade de comunicação com diversos perfis de stakeholders;
  • Habilidade de trabalhar em equipes ágeis e multidisciplinares;
  • Criatividade e Proatividade para imaginar diferentes cenários de uso das aplicações;
  • Organização.

  • Experience com banco de dados relacional (SQLServer, MySql, Postgres)
  • Design Patterns;
  • Experiência com testes unitários (TDD);
  • Conhecimento em GIT;
  • Conhecimento de metodologias ágeis (Scrum);
  • Conhecimento em Docker, Kubernets;
  • Conhecimento em frameworks de messageria (Kafka, ActiveMQ, RabbitMQ, etc..);
  • Boa comunicação e trabalho em equipe;
  • Capacidade de escrever código robusto, testável e validado;
  • Conhecimento em aplicações que precisem responder em alta disponibilidade e alta performance.

Desejáveis:

  • Conhecimento de Mercado Financeiro;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de Code Quality (sonar);
  • Experiência com ferramentas de APM (Dynatrace, AppDynamics, DataDog, etc...);
  • Conhecimento em Prometheus, metricas e monitoramento;
  • Experiência com aplicações SPA;
  • Conhecimento em ElasticSearch, Apache Lucene e GraphQL;
  • Experiência trabalhando com implantação e gerenciamento de nuvem;
  • Experiência com gerenciamento e implantação de CI/CD.

Soft Skills:

  • Raciocínio lógico e capacidade analítica;
  • Boa Comunicação;
  • Espírito de equipe e capacidade de resolução de conflitos;
  • Ter capacidade de comunicação com diversos perfis de stakeholders;
  • Habilidade de trabalhar em equipes ágeis e multidisciplinares;
  • Criatividade e Proatividade para imaginar diferentes cenários de uso das aplicações;
  • Organização.
